effects.name: Block
effects.short: cancels opposing cards of equal or lower value
effects.long: Cancels every opposing card of equal or lower value.

effects.name: Steal
effects.long: Take 1 gem from your opponent, then score as normal.

effects.name: Skip
effects.long: Your opponent skips their next turn.

effects.name: Both
effects.long: Play a card into your other slot too.
